d: India’s car market is seeing a shift as alternative-fuel vehicles collectively overtake petrol cars in monthly sales for the first time. In this video, Firstpost examines the August numbers, when CNG vehicles, hybrids and electric vehicles together accounted for 41.9% of passenger-vehicle sales, compared with 40.8% for petrol cars. The video explains what is driving the change, including running costs, the ongoing E20 fuel debate and higher oil prices linked to tensions in West Asia.
